name: A disabled user cannot sign in, and re-enabling restores sign-in
description:
Objective: A disabled user cannot sign in, and re-enabling restores sign-in.
Preconditions: Kesef CRM QA; USER_MANAGEMENT_VIEWER_* names an active account with no Access Management permission; USER_MANAGEMENT_MANAGER_* names a dedicated non-admin account the suite may disable and re-enable. Without them the test fails as BLOCKED.
Steps:
1. As Superadmin, disable the lifecycle account.
2. Sign in with that account in a fresh context.
3. Re-enable it.
Expected: Sign-in is refused while disabled; the account is active again afterwards.
